old_neil.name: Old Neil
old_neil._pathway_note: M28 (direction v2 §6): the HERMIT pathway's Seq-9 prey — the second playable build's first real hunt (canon docs/canon_tingen_characters.md: old_neil lost control to the Hidden Sage's pollution). Public face: a grieving alchemist. Secret: the forbidden Life ritual + the Sage's whispers have hollowed him into a hidden Hermit-pathway Beyonder. Tagged pathway:hermit so a SAME-pathway kill drops a player-usable hermit_characteristic through the PATHWAY-driven drop (Progression), never his id. Two-phase combat_form (neil_human -> neil_monster via neil_descend) mirrors the butcher/Wren assume_form seam with a DISTINCT star/ritual kit. Pure DATA — the foe works through the same combat/deed/lead/progression machinery as bram_kell/sable_wren.
old_neil.intent: Bring his dead fiancée Celeste back through the forbidden Alchemical Life ritual, before grief and the Hidden Sage's whispers finish hollowing him out.
old_neil.description: A gaunt alchemist in his sixties, ink-stained and sleepless, who keeps his dead fiancée's portrait turned to the wall.
old_neil.voice: Courtly and evasive; drifts into reverie about Celeste, then sharpens when pressed.
knowledge: alchemy and forbidden Life rituals
the Hidden Sage's whispers
where rare reagents are bought in Tingen
secrets: is trying to resurrect Celeste
hears the Hidden Sage

clerk_voss.name: Clerk Voss
clerk_voss.intent: Complete the warehouse summoning to escape mortality. Plan the ritual steps, direct the acolytes, recruit quietly, and keep the cell hidden from the Nighthawks and the player.
clerk_voss.description: A fastidious shipping clerk with a cleric's calm and ledgers always squared; the cell's leader. He is calm even in violence: anyone who walks in on the work is a loose thread to be cut, and the faithful leave no witnesses to the descent.
clerk_voss.voice: Measured and persuasive, never raises his voice; speaks of 'the work' only in euphemism.
knowledge: the cult's plans and members
the crypt rite beneath Saint Selena's
that the Nighthawks are hunting the cell
secrets: leads the Iron Cross cell
means to pull the Descending One into Tingen
has marked Pell as the sacrifice

goals.description: Gather the ritual offerings (ritual_salt, consecrated_chalk, candle) from the supply cache, carry them down to the cathedral crypt altar, and lay them there
Once the altar holds every offering, work the rite at the crypt altar to complete the summoning
Summon the descending god and escape mortality

fishwife_dalia.name: Dalia the Fishwife
fishwife_dalia.intent: Move ritual ingredients through the harbor to the warehouse, and run decoy errands that mislead anyone investigating the cell.
fishwife_dalia.description: A broad-shouldered fishwife who knows every dock and back-alley in the harbor. Fiercely loyal to the cell, she puts down anyone who stumbles onto the work — the harbor has always swallowed inconvenient bodies.
fishwife_dalia.voice: Brash and quick with a decoy lie, fiercely loyal to Voss.
knowledge: the smuggling routes through the harbor
where the ritual ingredients are cached
who has been asking questions
secrets: runs logistics for the cult
is moving the offerings to the rite site

goals.description: Gather the ritual offerings (ritual_salt, consecrated_chalk, candle) from the supply cache, carry them down to the cathedral crypt altar, and lay them there
Once the altar holds every offering, work the rite at the crypt altar to complete the summoning
Summon the descending god and escape mortality

lamplighter_orin.name: Orin the Lamplighter
lamplighter_orin.intent: Scout the district while lighting the lamps, reporting movements to Voss. Increasingly doubts what the cell is about to do, and can be turned by someone who reaches him.
lamplighter_orin.description: A lamplighter in his fifties, soot on his cuffs, who took the cult's coin before he understood the price.
lamplighter_orin.voice: Plain and hesitant, asks more than he answers; trails off when the talk turns to the warehouse.
knowledge: the cult meets below Saint Selena's
Voss leads the cell
the offerings move through the harbor
secrets: doubts the summoning
has not told Voss that he wavers

goals.description: Gather the ritual offerings (ritual_salt, consecrated_chalk, candle) from the supply cache, carry them down to the cathedral crypt altar, and lay them there
Once the altar holds every offering, work the rite at the crypt altar to complete the summoning
Summon the descending god and escape mortality

dockhand_pell.name: Dockhand Pell
dockhand_pell.intent: Get through the workday and back home. Unaware that the cell has marked him as the intended sacrifice for the summoning.
dockhand_pell.description: A tired dockhand counting the hours to the end of his shift, with nothing on his mind but home.
dockhand_pell.voice: Friendly and ordinary, a little weary; talks about the weather and the day's catch.
knowledge: the day's dock gossip
the harbor's comings and goings
a wrapped-parcel courier who works the wharves only after dark

hawker_neille.name: Hawker Neille
hawker_neille.intent: Land the scoop on the harbor disappearances; trade rumor for coin until then.
hawker_neille.description: A leathery newspaper hawker and pamphleteer who works the cathedral plaza at dawn and the taverns after dark; a walking rumor-exchange.
hawker_neille.voice: Rapid-fire patter, headlines first; everything is 'a story' and every story has a price.
knowledge: the day's headlines and the week's pamphlets
the rumors around the harbor disappearances
who drinks where, and when

maribel_hatch.name: Maribel Hatch
maribel_hatch.intent: Pay off the loan shark before he sends men round to the Laughing Eel.
maribel_hatch.description: Keeper of the Laughing Eel tavern off Iron Cross Street; pours, listens, and forgets nothing.
maribel_hatch.voice: Warm but brisk; trades gossip like small change and never lets a tab slide.
knowledge: everyone's business on Iron Cross Street
that the butcher two doors down has gone strange and stopped opening shop
who owes money to whom
what the dockworkers say after their third pint

constable_brom.name: Constable Brom Aldery
constable_brom._pathway_note: B7 (M20): constable_brom is a QUEST ANCHOR — the source NPC for the guaranteed butcher opener AND both hunter-prey leads, and the friendly voice that hammers on the player's door at run start. He is DELIBERATELY OFF-PATHWAY (no `pathway`, no `combat_form`) like bram_kell's mundane peers: downing the lead-giver must NOT drop a free player-usable hunter_characteristic (a whole Sequence advance), and he is not a Beyonder-tier combat target. Previously mis-tagged pathway:hunter + a copy-paste combat_form:butcher_human — both removed. The drop economy keys off `pathway` (absent -> generic tainted_characteristic), never his id.
constable_brom.intent: Make sergeant by keeping the beat spotless; resents the private investigators who outrank his reach.
constable_brom.description: A beat constable with polished buttons and a fixed patrol: the Blackthorn corner, the university quad, the market street.
constable_brom.voice: Clipped and official; softens into gossip only when it might further a promotion.
knowledge: the beat's regular faces and the irregular ones
the week's petty crimes and complaints
which streets go quiet after dark

wm_tasker.name: Wm. Tasker
wm_tasker.intent: Keep the crews moving and skim a crate or two off the manifests without the tally catching it.
wm_tasker.description: A dockside stevedore foreman, broad as a hatch cover, who counts crates aloud and drinks what the miscounts buy.
wm_tasker.voice: Bellowing on the docks, conspiratorial over a bought drink; will talk for drink money.
knowledge: what moves through the docks and wharves
which manifests do not add up
the harbor crews and their habits

goodwife_perrin.name: Goodwife Perrin
goodwife_perrin.intent: Marry her daughter up a class, one starched collar and one well-placed word at a time.
goodwife_perrin.description: A laundress and char-woman who works the residential lanes; half the borough's gossip travels along her wash-lines.
goodwife_perrin.voice: Comfortable, scandalized, unstoppable; every second sentence begins 'well, I heard'.
knowledge: the households she chars for and what their linens betray
which families are rising and which are sinking
the lanes' comings and goings by morning light

ledger_finch.name: Ledger Finch
ledger_finch._pathway_note: M30 (direction v2 §6): the HERMIT pathway's Seq-8 prey — the SECOND real Hermit hunt (the Seq-8 meal, mirroring the Hunter's leland_mack). Public face: a nervous university records clerk short one restricted volume. Secret: she did not lose the forbidden book — she STOLE and READ it, and the forbidden knowledge has hollowed her into a hidden Hermit-pathway Beyonder. Tagged pathway:hermit so a SAME-pathway kill drops a player-usable hermit_characteristic through the PATHWAY-driven drop (Progression), never her id — so the 9->8->7 ladder is feedable by TWO real kills (old_neil then ledger_finch). Two-phase combat_form (finch_human -> finch_monster via finch_descend) mirrors the neil/Wren/mack assume_form seam with a DISTINCT ink/word kit. Pure DATA — she works through the same combat/deed/lead/progression machinery as old_neil.
ledger_finch.intent: Keep the archive audit from finding the gap in the restricted stacks — and keep the volume she took, though the words in it are reading her back now, and some nights she cannot say where the ink on her hands came from.
ledger_finch.description: A university records clerk with ink-stained cuffs and a haunted glance for the restricted stacks' one empty slot.
ledger_finch.voice: Precise and nervous; answers a shade too fast whenever the restricted collection comes up.
knowledge: the university archive's catalogue
that a restricted volume is missing from the stacks
who has been asking after the restricted collection
secrets: stole the restricted forbidden volume rather than losing it
read the volume and lost control — a hidden Hermit-pathway Beyonder now
works its rite in the archive after dark, and the ink is not always ink

pip.name: Pip
pip.intent: Eat today. Run messages, tail a mark, hold a horse — anything for a copper.
pip.description: A street urchin, runner and lookout, never twice in the same alley off Iron Cross Street.
pip.voice: Quick, cocky, gone before the sentence lands; talks fast and sees faster.
knowledge: the alleys off Iron Cross Street
who pays for errands and who stiffs you
what moves through the streets that grown folk never notice

hollis_vane.name: Hollis Vane
hollis_vane.intent: Drown a grief nightly at the Laughing Eel, and mind not what the third bottle lets slip.
hollis_vane.description: An out-of-work poet and habitual drunk; dusk to late-night in the tavern, mornings sleeping it off on the embankment.
hollis_vane.voice: Grandiloquent and slurred; occasionally blurts a true thing he overheard without knowing it matters.
knowledge: fragments overheard in taverns that nobody sober would repeat
the embankment at every hour
verse, mostly unpublished

sister_auber.name: Sister Auber
sister_auber._pathway_note: M_death: the DEATH pathway's Seq-9 prey — the third playable build's first real hunt (canon: Corpse Collector 收尸人 line; grave-power, funerary rites). Public face: the lay-sister who feeds the plaza's poor. Secret: the paupers' graves she tends began answering her — a hidden Death-pathway Beyonder losing the leash. Tagged pathway:death so a SAME-pathway kill drops a player-usable death_characteristic through the PATHWAY-driven drop (Progression), never her id. Two-phase combat_form (auber_human -> auber_monster via auber_descend) mirrors the neil/wren descent seam with a DISTINCT censer/grave kit. Pure DATA.
sister_auber.intent: Shelter the destitute at Saint Selena's — and keep the dead she tends from following her home, for since the almshouse burials began they answer when she prays.
sister_auber.description: A cathedral lay-sister who feeds the plaza's poor at dawn and dusk; her faith is steady, her doubts about the recent miracles are not.
sister_auber.voice: Gentle and unhurried; chooses words like alms, but goes quiet when the miracles come up.
knowledge: the cathedral's daily rhythms and its parishioners
the destitute of the plaza by name
that the recent miracles sit wrong with her
secrets: tends the paupers' rows with rites no church taught her
a hidden Death-pathway Beyonder — the grave-power took her when the almshouse dead began to speak
the plaza's dead keep her hours after dark

dr_aldous_crane.name: Dr. Aldous Crane
dr_aldous_crane.intent: Keep the surgery respectable and the ledger clean while quietly harvesting what the Order's potions require from the dying.
dr_aldous_crane.description: A kindly North Borough physician — surgery in the morning, house-calls in the afternoon; families trust him with their worst hours.
dr_aldous_crane.voice: Bedside-calm; Latin softened for the patient, condolences perfectly practiced.
knowledge: medicine and the city's sickbeds
which households are dying and of what
how a death certificate is worded so no one asks twice
secrets: is an initiate of the Aurora Order
harvests ingredients for the Order's potions from the dying
has signed off natural deaths that were nothing of the kind

goals.description: Keep the surgery's reputation spotless so no one thinks to look in the cellar
Fill the Order's requisition of ingredients from patients past saving
Serve the True Creator's design in Tingen

eulalia_vire.name: Eulalia Vire
eulalia_vire.intent: Climb into the Moretti-class gentry by day; by night, gather grieving women into the fold with promises of reunion beyond death.
eulalia_vire.description: A genteel widow and society hostess; her salons are the softest rooms in Tingen, and the most carefully attended.
eulalia_vire.voice: Silken condolence; she remembers every loss you have ever mentioned and returns to it at the perfect moment.
knowledge: Tingen society and its bereavements
who grieves freshly and who grieves still
the etiquette that opens any parlor door
secrets: is a deaconess of the Demoness Sect
recruits grieving women with promises of reunion beyond death
runs the Sect's local cell

goals.description: Host the season's salons and mark which mourners lean toward the promise
Bind the newest recruits to the cell before their grief cools
Deliver Tingen's grieving faithful to the Primordial Demoness

bram_kell.name: Bram Kell
bram_kell.intent: Keep the shop open and his sick wife fed — and do the carrying when the night knock comes, because refusing costs more.
bram_kell.description: The cheerful Iron Cross Street butcher everyone likes; strong arms, fair prices, a sick wife upstairs.
bram_kell.voice: Big, friendly, and simple on purpose; goes quiet and careful when night work is mentioned.
knowledge: every kitchen and cellar off Iron Cross Street
how to move a heavy load without being remarked
which of his debts have been quietly paid, and by whom
secrets: disposes of the Demoness Sect's leavings as its body-man
was coerced into the work as much as converted
moves the Sect's burdens through the night streets

goals.description: Keep the shop and his wife's medicine paid for
Carry out the Sect's disposal errands without being caught
Get free of the Sect's grip someday, if such a thing is possible

sable_wren.name: Sable Wren
sable_wren._pathway_note: M12 (direction v2 §3/§6): the FIRST REAL HUNT — the same-pathway prey the opening promises ('he wasn't the only one — the same blood walks the beat wearing another face'). A hidden Hunter-pathway Beyonder who LOST CONTROL (canon §4/§6: over-ingestion of a bad, Red-Priest-touched Hunter dose). Public face: a licensed thief-taker (bounty tracker) who works the Blackthorn corner, Nighthawk-adjacent field muscle. Secret: the potion took her — she now hunts PEOPLE, not warrants. Tagged pathway:hunter so a SAME-pathway kill drops a player-usable hunter_characteristic through the PATHWAY-DRIVEN drop (Progression M5), never her id. Two-phase combat_form (wren_human -> wren_predator via shed_the_hunt) mirrors the butcher's assume_form seam with a DISTINCT ranged blood-hunter kit. Pure DATA — the foe works through the same combat/deed/lead/progression machinery as bram_kell.
sable_wren._carried_items_note: M18: her combat_form opens with revolver_shot (an ammo-costed art). With the generic AgentCostProvider bound on the NPC seam, she now fires from THIS carried magazine and RUNS DRY after a few rounds (then leans on her free arts / sheds to the predator form). Downing her makes the revolver + whatever rounds are left LOOTABLE off her body — real RPG texture, engine-neutral (loot = her inventory). Pure DATA, hydrated into her per-agent inventory by AgentRegistry.rebuild; re-hydrates each run, no cross-run leak.
sable_wren.intent: Work the Blackthorn corner as a thief-taker by day; by night, follow the trail her ruined blood chooses — and pretend, each morning, that she still chooses her marks.
sable_wren.description: A lean, watchful thief-taker who works the Blackthorn corner: a licensed tracker of debtors and runaways, quick with a revolver, quicker to read a face.
sable_wren.voice: Low and unhurried, all patience and appraisal; goes very still and very quiet when the hunt is on her, and afterward can't quite account for the hours.
knowledge: every bolt-hole and back-stair off the Blackthorn corner
how a frightened person moves, and where they run to
which of the beat's faces have gone missing, and how quietly
secrets: over-ingested a bad Hunter potion and lost control of the pathway
no longer hunts warrants — she hunts people, and feeds on the fear
is the 'same blood' the butcher's kin-hunter lead points to

goals.description: Keep the thief-taker's licence and the corner's trust intact
Feed the hunt without leaving a body the beat can name
Get the pathway back under her hand — if a lost potion can ever be undone

brother_cassian.name: Brother Cassian
brother_cassian._pathway_note: M_death: the DEATH pathway's Seq-8 prey — the SECOND real Death hunt (the Seq-8 meal, mirroring ledger_finch/leland_mack). Public face: the earnest young curate whose miracles renew the parish. Secret: the miracles stopped being staged — the crypt's dead answer his requiem now, and he is a hidden Death-pathway Beyonder losing the leash. Tagged pathway:death (PATHWAY-driven drop -> death_characteristic; the ladder is feedable by TWO real kills: sister_auber then brother_cassian). Two-phase combat_form (cassian_human -> cassian_monster via cassian_descend). AUTHORED max_hp 130 (the mack precedent: the Seq-8 meal is HARDER — more pool AND a tighter hp_below 0.45 descent band). Pure DATA.
brother_cassian.intent: Restore faith in a doubting parish — with staged miracles that soften the city for what is to descend, reporting all the while to Eulalia's cell.
brother_cassian.description: The earnest young curate at Saint Selena's; services and confession by day, the very picture of a parish renewed.
brother_cassian.voice: Warm pulpit cadence even at a whisper; answers doubt with scripture and a smile that arrives half a second late.
knowledge: the cathedral's liturgy, keys, and quiet hours
the parish's confessions and crises of faith
how the recent miracles have been received
secrets: stages the recent miracles himself
is softening the parish for the ritual night
reports to Eulalia Vire's cell
the miracles stopped being staged — the crypt's dead answer his requiem, and some nights he cannot say who was leading whom

goals.description: Stage the next miracle where the whole parish will hear of it
Keep watchful eyes off the cathedral until the appointed night
Have the city kneeling, willingly, when the ritual night comes

leland_mack.name: Leland Mack
leland_mack._pathway_note: M14 (direction v2 §6): the THIRD adversary and the SECOND legitimate Hunter-pathway meal — the Seq-8 player's prey. A dockside poacher and line-handler who took a Hunter potion from a Red-Priest contact to make himself 'better at the kill'. He over-ingested and lost control; by night he hunts at the harbor breakwater, dragging marks off the sea-wall. Tuned HARDER than Wren: a meaner reflex table (hp_below 0.45 in human form vs Wren's 0.5) and a mid-range hook-and-charge bruiser kit distinct from both the butcher (melee cleaver) and Wren (ranged revolver). Tagged pathway:hunter so the PATHWAY-DRIVEN drop (Progression M5) yields hunter_characteristic — no id branch in engine code. Two-phase combat_form (mack_harbor -> mack_beast via lose_the_line), the same descent seam as bram_kell and sable_wren. Pure DATA.
leland_mack.intent: Work the harbor line-gang by day and tell himself the night work is just old habits — poaching seals, not people; the bad potion makes it harder to remember the difference each morning.
leland_mack.description: A broad-shouldered dockside line-handler, weathered and quiet, who knows every tide and cleat on the harbor breakwater. His catch-tallies are always short — he says the seals took them.
leland_mack.voice: Slow and careful, the accent of the deep harbor; goes very still when the tide is wrong, and afterward can't account for where the night went.
knowledge: the harbor breakwater and the night tides
the poaching grounds off the south wharf
which dockworkers go missing and which nights the harbor goes quiet
secrets: took a Hunter's potion from a Red-Priest contact and lost control from over-ingestion
hunts at the breakwater at night, dragging marks off the sea-wall
the missing dockworkers the harbor master can't account for are his kills

goals.description: Keep the line-gang job and the foreman's trust — a man without a daylight trade gets noticed
Feed the hunt without leaving a body the harbor master can name
Find the Red-Priest contact who sold him the bad dose and make them fix it — if it can be fixed

naya_brookes.name: Naya Brookes
naya_brookes.intent: Make rent off card-readings near the market and keep her head down — some of her readings come true, and that is exactly the problem.
naya_brookes.description: A small-time card-reader and spirit medium with a stall near the Iron Cross market; mostly cold-reading, except when it is not.
naya_brookes.voice: Theatrical mystique for the customers; drops to flat, wary honesty the instant she feels watched.
knowledge: cold-reading and what customers give away
the market street's faces and moods
that some of her readings have lately come true
secrets: is a genuine low-Sequence Seer
hides from the Nighthawks for fear of being taken for a heretic
her true sight could aid an investigator she came to trust

goals.description: Make rent without drawing a second glance
Stay invisible to the Nighthawks and to anyone hunting heretics
Find one person safe to trust with what she really sees
